see_title: Where you’ll see this in Pet Aura

topics.title: The Sun sign – your pet’s basic nature
p: The Sun sign is what we usually just call someone’s “star sign”. It shows which sign of the zodiac the Sun was in when your pet was born.
In astrology, the Sun stands for a being’s basic nature: it expresses the fundamental energies and qualities that characterize your pet.

The twelve signs belong to four elements: fire, earth, air or water. Fire signs are lively and enthusiastic, earth signs calm and steady, air signs curious and light-hearted, water signs sensitive and intuitive. A Taurus dog, for example, carries the calm of the earth signs: they love their usual walk and familiar places.
The date of birth is enough for the Sun sign, so it is almost always known. It is only uncertain if your pet was born on the very day the Sun moved into a new sign.
topics.see: In Cosmic Paw, it is the first row in “Your pet’s celestial profile”, with a title and a longer description. The element medallion shown next to the portrait also comes from here. If the sign is uncertain because of a sign change, the app tells you and asks for the birth time and place to give you the exact sign.

topics.title: The Moon sign – the world of feelings and security
p: The Moon sign shows which sign of the zodiac the Moon was in when your pet was born. It is less well known than the Sun sign, but it rounds out your pet’s celestial profile from another side.
In astrology, the Moon stands for feelings, moods and a sense of security. While the Sun expresses your pet’s basic nature, the Moon expresses what your pet needs in order to feel good.
A Moon in a water sign, for example, points to the importance of a calm, familiar environment and closeness. A Moon in a fire sign tends to show a need for movement, play and new experiences.
The Moon moves quickly across the sky: it changes sign about every two and a half days. So if no birth time is given, two signs may come into question on the day of birth.
topics.see: In Cosmic Paw, the Moon sign is the second row in “Your pet’s celestial profile”. If the Moon changed sign on the day of birth, the app shows that the sign is approximate and asks for the birth time and place to give you the exact sign.

topics.title: The rising sign and the houses – a trace of the moment of birth
p: The rising sign (also called the ascendant) and the houses are the most personal parts of a birth chart. They depend not only on the day of birth, but also on exactly when and where your pet was born.

The rising sign is the sign that was rising on the eastern horizon at the moment of birth. In astrology, it represents how your pet steps out into the world: the first impression they make and how they approach new situations.

The houses divide the sky into twelve parts, according to different areas of life. Such areas include home, play, relationships and retreat. When a planet falls into a particular house, according to astrological interpretation the theme it represents is linked to that area of life.

The rising sign changes fairly quickly: on average, a new sign rises on the eastern horizon about every two hours. The positions of the houses also depend on the exact time and place of birth. If either is missing, these parts can’t be calculated reliably.
topics.see: If you’ve given the birth time and place, the third row of the celestial profile in Cosmic Paw is the rising sign, and the “Planets in the houses” chapter appears too. If either detail is missing, the app tells you, and you can add it on your pet’s profile.

topics.title: The planets – the characters of the personality
p: Besides the Sun and the Moon, astrology works with eight more celestial bodies. Each one represents a different side of the personality.

If we imagine the birth chart as a play, the planets are its characters. Mercury stands for curiosity and communication, Venus for attachment and enjoyment, Mars for energy and courage, Jupiter for openness and joy, and Saturn for perseverance and order.

The more distant planets, Uranus, Neptune and Pluto, move slowly. That’s why animals born around the same time often have them in the same sign, and they tend to color the deeper, more general layers. Astronomy today classifies Pluto as a dwarf planet, but astrology traditionally counts it among the planets.
How a character “plays” its role is shown by the sign and the house it stands in. That’s what the next topic is about.
topics.see: In Cosmic Paw, in the “Planets in the signs” chapter, every planet gets its own medallion, next to the sign it was in when your pet was born. And in “Today’s sky” you can see which sign the Moon is moving through today, and also whether Mercury is retrograde, that is, appears to be moving backwards.

topics.title: A planet in a sign and a house – who, how and where
p: Each line of the birth chart always links three things: a planet, a sign and, if the birth time and place are known, a house. Together they give the full meaning.

Let’s stay at the theater. The planet is the character: it shows what the line is about, for example energy or attachment. The sign is the playing style: it represents how this quality shows itself. And the house is the stage: the area of life it is linked to, according to astrological interpretation.

An example: Mars stands for energy. If it is in Gemini, this energy, according to interpretation, shows itself in a quick, curious and versatile way. If it is also in the fifth house, the area of play, this drive shows most of all in play.
So the same planet can tell a very different story for two animals, depending on the sign and house it stands in.
topics.see: In Cosmic Paw, every row in the “Planets in the signs” and “Planets in the houses” chapters is one such pairing. The planet’s medallion stands next to the row, and the “Read more” button opens the full description on the parchment.

topics.title: Aspects – how the planets talk to each other
p: An aspect shows the angle two planets formed with each other when your pet was born. According to astrological interpretation, this determines how they influence each other.

If the planets are the characters, the aspects are the conversations between them. Pet Aura takes five aspects into account:
- **Conjunction:** the two planets stand almost in the same place; their qualities intertwine and can strengthen each other.
- **Sextile and Trine:** an easy, harmonious conversation; the two qualities naturally support each other.
- **Square and Opposition:** a more tense conversation. This isn’t a bad sign: according to interpretation, it shows a duality that can give rise to drive and growth.
If Mars and Venus form a trine, then according to astrological interpretation energy and attachment connect in harmony. This might show up, for example, as a playful, affectionate way of bonding.
Because the Moon moves quickly, aspects involving the Moon are only approximate without a birth time.
topics.see: In the “Aspects” chapter of Cosmic Paw, the aspects are shown by type, each with its own symbol, alongside the pairs of planets between which they formed. Here too, the “Read more” button opens the full description.

topics.title: Feng Shui – the tradition of space and flowing energy
p: Feng Shui is an old Chinese tradition. Its name literally means “wind and water”, and it looks at how energy, called qi in Chinese, flows through a space.

According to Feng Shui, a space is never neutral. The direction, the arrangement of objects, the doors, the windows and the paths all influence how energy moves. According to the tradition, it’s easier to rest where this flow is calm and balanced.

Feng Shui has two important approaches. The compass approach deals with the meaning of the directions. The form approach deals with the shape of the surroundings: what protects the place from behind, where the paths lead, where the space narrows or gets crowded.
For a pet, the resting place is especially important, since that’s where they spend a large part of their time.
topics.see: Paw Feng Shui works in two steps. First, you choose, or measure with your phone’s compass, which direction your pet’s resting place lies in. Then you answer a few simple questions about its surroundings. When you tap “Reveal the energies”, the Feng Shui reading is created from these two pieces of information.

topics.title: The five elements – the five forces of nature
p: Chinese tradition describes the world as the interplay of five elements: wood, fire, earth, metal and water. They don’t just mean physical materials: they represent the different changes and qualities of nature.
**Wood** stands for growth and renewal, **fire** for joy and radiance, **earth** for stability and care, **metal** for clarity and order, and **water** for depth and flow.

According to the tradition, the elements also act on one another. In one cycle they nourish each other, the way wood feeds fire. In the other they keep each other in balance, the way water tames fire.

An important difference: the four elements of the zodiac signs (fire, earth, air, water) come from Western astrology, while the five elements come from Chinese tradition. Pet Aura uses both, but never mixes them up.
topics.see: In Paw Feng Shui, every direction has its element: water for North, fire for South, wood for East and Southeast, metal for West and Northwest, and earth for Northeast, Southwest and the Center. The reading also shows this element’s medallion and meaning.

topics.title: The directions – where your pet rests
p: Compass Feng Shui divides a space into nine parts: the eight directions and the center. Each has its own meaning and element.

The direction shows where your pet’s resting place lies in relation to the center of your home or the room. What matters isn’t which way your pet faces while sleeping, but which part of the space the spot is in.

According to the tradition, every direction carries a different energy. North is the world of depth and calm, South of light and liveliness, and East of new beginnings. The center is a special place: the tradition sees it as the heart of the space, connecting all the other directions.
If you don’t know exactly which direction the resting place is in, that’s fine. If you choose “I don’t know”, the reading is based on the questions about the surroundings.
topics.see: In Paw Feng Shui, you can choose the direction on the nine-square grid or measure it with your phone’s compass. The small “i” medallion shows you the steps: stand near the center of your home, hold your phone level, turn toward the resting place and lock in the direction.

topics.title: The Bagua map – the circle of the eight trigrams
p: The Bagua is one of the best-known symbols of Feng Shui: an eight-sided map on which each direction has its own trigram.

A trigram is made of three lines stacked on top of each other, and each line can be solid or broken. Each of the eight possible combinations stands for an image from nature. North has water (Kan), Northeast the mountain (Gen), East thunder (Zhen), Southeast wind (Xun), South fire (Li), Southwest the earth (Kun), West the lake (Dui) and Northwest heaven (Qian).

Pet Aura follows Feng Shui’s so-called Later Heaven arrangement, which links the directions with their trigrams. On traditional Chinese maps, South is at the top, which is why South is also at the top of the app’s compass dial, and North at the bottom.
The center has no trigram: it is the heart of the nine-square Luo Shu grid, marked in Pet Aura by a medallion of its own.
topics.see: On the Paw Feng Shui grid, every direction button carries its trigram. At the top of the reading, the medallion of the chosen zone also appears with its trigram.

topics.title: The resting place’s surroundings – what the form reveals
p: Form Feng Shui doesn’t look at the direction, but at the immediate surroundings of the spot: what’s behind it, what’s next to it, and how it can be reached.
According to the tradition, a good resting place has a protected back. This is the meaning of the image of the Black Tortoise: a wall or piece of furniture behind gives a sense of safety.

Where there’s a lot of coming and going, for example near a door, hallway or passage, the energy is more restless according to the tradition. It’s also worth paying attention if a door and window face each other, if a long, straight hallway leads toward the spot, if it can only be reached through a narrow passage, or if its surroundings are cluttered.
A draft is a separate case. It isn’t a Feng Shui symbol, but a simple observation that affects your pet’s comfort.
topics.see: In Paw Feng Shui, you can answer seven simple questions with yes, no or “I don’t know”. Based on a predefined order of priority, the reading highlights one feature of the surroundings, and mentions a draft as a separate note.
